tasks.name: Audit source assets; lock palette and typography
tasks.description: Confirm the approved Magic Mirror marks and Acid Dispatch palette, select real display and UI/body fonts, document disallowed colors and the shade-generation method, and create base tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Approved wordmark, combined lockup, icon, favicon, and palette sources are recorded with durable repository paths.
Approved palette hex values, disallowed colors, and a documented derived-shade method are recorded.
Real display and UI/body font families are selected, with sources, licenses, local files or durable references, and fallback stacks recorded.
Base color and typography token JSON/CSS files exist under company/brand/brandbook-packet/tokens/.
tasks.verification: manual + command review: record source paths, confirmed hex values, font files/sources, shade method, token parse results, and any blockers in notes
tasks.notes: Passed T001 audit. Verified 5 durable sources (wordmark, combined lockup, icon, simplified favicon, palette), all 7 Acid Dispatch anchors, and documented OKLab-derived scales. Locked Instrument Serif Regular/Italic for display and Space Grotesk variable 300–700 for UI/body; 3 font files and both OFL 1.1 licenses are local. Generated deterministic tokens/brand-tokens.json, tokens/brand-tokens.css, and tokens/derived-palette.json with 30 CSS color variables, 4 radius tokens, focus/state tokens, and 21 derived scale entries. Evidence: company/brand/brandbook-packet/references/source-audit.md and references/t001-audit.json.

acceptance_criteria: company/brand/brandbook-packet/asset-plan.md exists.
The plan has one row for each of the 19 pages and maps every page to its required assets.
Every mockup family has a method, exact input paths, prompt or screenshot plan, output path, and verification checklist.
The plan distinguishes ImageGen mockups from deterministic HTML/CSS raster screenshots.
tasks.verification: manual review: record page-row count, planned mockup list, generation order, resolved input paths, and method counts in notes
tasks.notes: Passed T002 audit. asset-plan.md contains exactly 19 numbered page rows, verifies 10 durable inputs, and plans 7 final raster mockups: 4 ImageGen physical mockups (business card, billboard, T-shirt, compact mirror) plus 3 deterministic HTML/CSS screenshots (browser/favicon, X, LinkedIn). Every family has exact inputs via source aliases, a complete prompt/screenshot plan, PNG output path, target dimensions, and QA criteria. All mockup outputs were confirmed absent before generation. Evidence: company/brand/brandbook-packet/references/t002-audit.json.

tasks.verification: visual review + file check: record dimensions, bytes, source/method, small-size legibility, and final paths
tasks.notes: Passed T005 deterministic render, DOM, file, and visual audits. Created source/specimens/browser-favicon.html and rendered mockups/browser-favicon.png with Playwright 1.61.1/Chromium at 1600×1000 and device scale 1. Exact title and .example address matched; the simplified favicon measured true 16×16px in both the tab and specimen, while the complete icon measured 32×32px and 64×64px. All local images and both local font families loaded, the HTML contains zero literal hex colors, no browser trademark artwork appears, and the original-resolution screenshot had no clipping. Final PNG is 123,593 bytes, SHA-256 9816b6fb7a94726cc3e733c1db4cc9cbceac23111230a832b8139587cebbbf2e. Evidence: company/brand/brandbook-packet/references/t005-audit.json.
